76000.meaning1: with the disease; who is oppressed

76001.meaning1: having oppressed; having tormented; having afflicted; having caused discomfort (for)

examples.text: ko hi tassa janen'attho, janena janitena vā, janaṃ ohāya gacchaṃ taṃ, bādhayitvā bahuṃ janan'ti.

76002.meaning1: pot of curd; clay bowl of sour milk
76002.commentary: (THa) sīsañ'ca bhetvā dadhithālakaṃ'vā'ti matasarīrassa sīsaṃ bhinditvā bhinnattā eva leḍḍudaṇḍ'ādīhi paggharantaṃ dadhithālakaṃ viya, paggharantaṃ matthaluṅgaṃ katvā'ti attho.

examples.text: kāḷī itthī brahatī dhaṅkarūpā, satthiñ'ca bhetvā aparañ'ca satthiṃ, bāhañ'ca bhetvā aparañ'ca bāhaṃ, sīsañ'ca bhetvā dadhithālakaṃ'va, esā nisinnā abhisandahitvā.

76003.meaning1: having placed back together; having collected in a pile
76003.commentary: (THa) esā nisinnā abhisandahitvā'ti chinnabhinn'āvayavaṃ matasarīraṃ te avayave yathāṭhāne'y'eva ṭhapanena sandahitvā sahitaṃ katvā maṃs'āpaṇaṃ pasārentī viya esā nisinnā.

examples.text: kāḷī itthī brahatī dhaṅkarūpā, satthiñ'ca bhetvā aparañ'ca satthiṃ, bāhañ'ca bhetvā aparañ'ca bāhaṃ, sīsañ'ca bhetvā dadhithālakaṃ'va, esā nisinnā abhisandahitvā.

76004.meaning1: with a broken skull; with head cracked open
76004.commentary: (THa) m'āhaṃ puna bhinnasiro sayissan'ti yatha'y'idaṃ matasarīraṃ bhinnasarīraṃ sayati, evaṃ kiles'ūpadhīhi saṃsāre punappunaṃ uppattiyā kaṭasivaḍḍhako hutvā bhinnasiro ahaṃ mā sayissan'ti

examples.text: yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, m'āhaṃ puna bhinnasiro sayissan'ti.

76005.meaning1: with a head; with a skull

examples.text: yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, m'āhaṃ puna bhinnasiro sayissan'ti.

76006.meaning1: begged scraps in the bowl; gleaned food in the bowl
76006.commentary: (THa) uñchāpatt'āgate rato'ti uñchācariyāya patte āgate pattapariyāpanne abhirato, ten'eva santuṭṭho'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: pācīnavaṃsadāyamhi, sakyaputtā sahāyakā, pahāy'ānappake bhoge, uñchāpatt'āgate ratā.

76007.meaning1: having pulled out; having plucked out; having extracted; having uprooted

examples.text: so'haṃ khandhe pariññāya, abbahitvāna jāliniṃ, bhāvayitvāna bojjh'aṅge, nibbāyissaṃ anāsavo'ti.

76008.meaning1: having pulled out; having plucked out; having extracted; having uprooted

examples.text: so'haṃ khandhe pariññāya, abbuhitvāna jāliniṃ, bhāvayitvāna bojjh'aṅge, nibbāyissaṃ anāsavo'ti.

76009.meaning1: having cultivated; having developed; having meditated (on)
76009.commentary: (THa) tathā naṃ uddharanto'y'eva vuttappabhede bojjh'aṅge bhāvayitvāna te bhāvanāpāripūriṃ pāpetvā

examples.text: so'haṃ khandhe pariññāya, abbahitvāna jāliniṃ, bhāvayitvāna bojjh'aṅge, nibbāyissaṃ anāsavo'ti.

76010.commentary: (THa) yassa yūpo suvaṇṇayo'ti yassa rañño ayaṃ yūpo pāsādo suvaṇṇamayo.

examples.text: panādo nāma so rājā, yassa yūpo suvaṇṇayo, tiriyaṃ soḷas'ubbedho, ubbham'āhu sahassadhā.

76011.commentary: (THa) tiriyaṃ soḷas'ubbedho'ti vitthārato soḷasakaṇḍapātappamāṇo. so pana aḍḍhayojanamatto hoti.

examples.text: panādo nāma so rājā, yassa yūpo suvaṇṇayo, tiriyaṃ soḷas'ubbedho, ubbham'āhu sahassadhā.

76013.commentary: (THa) tiriyaṃ soḷas'ubbedho'ti vitthārato soḷasakaṇḍapātappamāṇo. so pana aḍḍhayojanamatto hoti.

examples.text: panādo nāma so rājā, yassa yūpo suvaṇṇayo, tiriyaṃ soḷas'ubbedho, ubbham'āhu sahassadhā.

76014.meaning1: with a thousand floors; (or) with one thousand apartments
76014.commentary: (THa) sahassakaṇḍo'ti sahassabhūmiko. (JAa) sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍū'ti so pan'esa sahassakaṇḍ'ubbedho pāsādo satabhūmiko ahosi.

examples.text: sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu, dhajālu haritāmayo, anaccuṃ tattha gandhabbā, chasahassāni sattadhā'ti.

76015.meaning1: with one hundred turrets; with a hundred towers
76015.commentary: (THa) satageṇḍū'ti anekasataniyyūhako. (JAa) sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍū'ti so pan'esa sahassakaṇḍ'ubbedho pāsādo satabhūmiko ahosi.

examples.text: sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu, dhajālu haritāmayo, anaccuṃ tattha gandhabbā, chasahassāni sattadhā'ti.

76016.commentary: (THa) haritāmayo'ti cāmīkarasuvaṇṇamayo. keci pana haritajātimaṇisarikkhako'ti vadanti. (JAa) haritāmayo'ti haritamaṇiparikkhitto. aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana samāluharitāmayo'ti pāṭho, haritamaṇimayehi dvārakavāṭa-vātapānehi samannāgato'ti attho.

examples.text: sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu, dhajālu haritāmayo, anaccuṃ tattha gandhabbā, chasahassāni sattadhā'ti.
sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu, dhajālu haritāmayo, anaccuṃ tattha gandhabbā, chasahassāni sattadhā'ti.
apāyimha anaccimha, agāyimha rudimha ca, visaññikaraṇiṃ pitvā, diṭṭhā n'āhumha vānarā'ti.

76018.meaning1: with strong energy aroused; actively applying effort
76018.commentary: (THa) saddh'ādibalānañ'c'eva catubbidha-sammappadhāna-vīriyassa ca saṃsiddhipāripūriyā āraddhabalavīriyo. saddh'ādīnañ'h'ettha balaggahaṇena gahaṇaṃ sati'pi satiādīnaṃ balabhāve, yathā gobalibaddhā puññañāṇasambhārā'ti.

examples.text: satimā paññavā bhikkhu, āraddhabalavīriyo, pañca kappasatān'āhaṃ, ekarattiṃ anussariṃ.

76019.meaning1: with strong energy; making a strenuous effort
76019.commentary: (THa) yaṃ kiccaṃ daḷhavīriyenā'ti daḷhena vīriyena thirena parakkamena, daḷhavīriyena vā purisadhorayhena yaṃ kiccaṃ kātabbaṃ paṭipajjitabbaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ kiccaṃ daḷhavīriyena, yaṃ kiccaṃ boddhum'icchatā, karissaṃ n'āvarajjhissaṃ, passa vīriyaṃ parakkama.
pabbajiṃ jīvik'attho'haṃ, laddhāna upasampadaṃ, tato saddhaṃ paṭilabhiṃ, daḷhavīriyo parakkamiṃ.

76020.meaning1: to awaken; to understand; to gain enlightenment
76020.commentary: (THa) yaṃ kiccaṃ boddhum'icchatā'ti cattāri ariyasaccāni nibbānam'eva vā boddhuṃ bujjhituṃ icchantena paṭivijjhitu'kāmena yaṃ kiccaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.

76021.meaning1: to awaken; to understand; to gain enlightenment
76021.commentary: (NIDD1a) taṃ bodhiṃ bujjhitu'kāmassā'ti taṃ catumaggañāṇasaṅkhātaṃ bodhiṃ bujjhituṃ icchantassa. (NIDD1a) atha vā bujjhitu'kāmassā'ti sotāpattimaggañāṇaṃ ñātukāmassa.

76022.meaning1: fact of having the wish to awaken; fact of having the desire to understand
76022.commentary: (THa) yaṃ kiccaṃ boddhum'icchatā'ti cattāri ariyasaccāni nibbānam'eva vā boddhuṃ bujjhituṃ icchantena paṭivijjhitu'kāmena yaṃ kiccaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ kiccaṃ daḷhavīriyena, yaṃ kiccaṃ boddhum'icchatā, karissaṃ n'āvarajjhissaṃ, passa vīriyaṃ parakkama.

76023.grammar: pr, from na avarajjhati, neg, intrans
76023.meaning1: does not miss; does not fail; does not falter
76023.construction:
na + ava + rajjha + ti
na + avarajjhati
76023.commentary: (THa) karissaṃ n'āvarajjhissan'ti tam'ahaṃ dāni karissaṃ na virādhessaṃ, yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjissāmi.

examples.text: yaṃ kiccaṃ daḷhavīriyena, yaṃ kiccaṃ boddhum'icchatā, karissaṃ n'āvarajjhissaṃ, passa vīriyaṃ parakkama.

76024.grammar: pr, pass of na avarundhati, neg, intrans
76024.meaning1: will not be opposed; will not rebel
76024.construction:
na + ava + rujjha + ti
na + avarujjhati

examples.text: yaṃ kiccaṃ daḷhavīriyena, yaṃ kiccaṃ boddhum'icchatā, karissaṃ n'āvarujjhissaṃ, passa vīriyaṃ parakkama.

76025.commentary: (THa) evaṃ paccavekkhato ca tuccho kāyo adissittha niccadhuvasukhasabhāv'ādīhi ritto hutvā me kāyo adissatha paññāyi.

examples.text: tuccho kāyo adissittha, andhakāro tamo byagā, sabbe coḷā samucchinnā, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.

76026.commentary: (THa) tuccho kāyo adissatha niccasār'ādivirahito tuccho khandhapañcakasaṅkhāto attabhāvakāyo ñāṇacakkhunā yāthāvato apassittha. sakalam'pi hi khandhapañcakaṃ avijjānivutassa, bhikkhave, bālassa taṇhāsaṃyuttassa evam'ayaṃ kāyo samudāgato'ti-ādīsu (saṃ. ni. 2.19) kāyo'ti vuccati. adissathā'ti ca iminā yadeva kāye daṭṭhabbaṃ, taṃ diṭṭhaṃ, na dānissa kiñci mayā passitabbaṃ atthī'ti katakiccataṃ dassento aññaṃ byākāsi.

examples.text: paccavekkhiṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ, sabbaṃ santarabāhiraṃ, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, tuccho kāyo adissathā'ti.
yāya no anukampāya, amhe pabbājayī muni, so no attho anuppatto, sabbasaṃyojanakkhayo'ti.

76028.commentary: (VINa) atha kho āyasmā sāriputto rāhulakumāraṃ pabbājesī'ti kumārassa mahāmoggallānatthero kese chinditvā kāsāyāni datvā saraṇāni adāsi.

examples.text: sā ca maṃ anukampāya, pabbājesi paṭācārā, tato maṃ ovaditvāna, param'atthe niyojayi.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, imehi tīhi saraṇagamanehi sāmaṇerapabbajjan'ti. atha kho āyasmā sāriputto rāhulaṃ kumāraṃ pabbājesi.

76029.meaning1: with army; with platoon; with squadron
76029.commentary: (ANa) jetvā māraṃ savāhinin'ti sasenakaṃ māraṃ jinitvā ṭhitā.

examples.text: nadanti evaṃ sappaññā, sīhā'va girigabbhare, vīrā vijitasaṅgāmā, jetvā māraṃ savāhaniṃ.

76030.meaning1: with army; with platoon; with squadron

examples.text: nadanti evaṃ sappaññā, sīhā'va girigabbhare, vīrā vijitasaṅgāmā, jetvā māraṃ savāhanaṃ.

76031.meaning1: slain passion for existence; killed desire to be; (or) afflicted by lust for life
76031.commentary: (THa) bhavarāgahatassa me sato'ti bhavarāgena bhavataṇhāya anādimati saṃsāre hatassa upaddutassa mama sato samānassa, aggamaggena vā hatabhavarāgassa.

examples.text: bhavarāgahatassa me sato, bhavarāgo puna me na vijjati, na c'āhu na ca me bhavissati, na ca me eta'r'ahi vijjatī'ti.

76036.meaning2: having celebrated the Pavāraṇa ceremony at the end of the Rains Retreat

examples.text: aṇuṃ aggiṃ'va sandhamaṃ, yathā paṇḍitapuriso parittaṃ aggiṃ anukkamena gomayacuṇṇ'ādīni pakkhipitvā mukhavātena dhamanto samuṭṭhāpeti vaḍḍheti mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ karoti

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pāsāṇe lekhā na khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati. so ca khv'assa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
yo imaṃ lekhaṃ antaraṃ karoti, rāj'āṇāya kāretabbo'ti. mahājanakajātake bodhisattena katalekhaṃ sīvalidevī antaraṃ kātuṃ avisahantī vivattamānā agamāsi.

76051.commentary: (THIa) saṇhakambu'r'iva suppamajjitā'ti suṭṭhu pamajjitā saṇhā suvaṇṇasaṅkhā viya.

examples.text: saṇhakambu'r'iva suppamajjitā, sobhate su gīvā pure mama, sā jarāya bhaggā vināmitā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
api ca tiṭṭhat'etaṃ, idāni'pi mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāma, ko nu kho āyasmantānaṃ sukhavihāritaro rājā vā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro āyasmā vā gotamo'ti?
handa, ca dāni mayaṃ, bhante, gacchāma, bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā'ti. yassa'dāni tvaṃ, pessa, kālaṃ maññasī'ti.

76059.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of abhiṇha
76059.construction:
abhi + √ikkh + aṇa + so
abhikkhaṇa > abhiṇha + so

examples.text: siyā, ānanda. tisso imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, kāmadhātu, rūpadhātu, arūpadhātu. imā kho, ānanda, tisso dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

76062.meaning1: recitation of the Vedas; reciting mantras; (comm) subject of speech

examples.text: tevijjānaṃ yadakkhātaṃ, tatra kevalino'smase, padakasmā veyyākaraṇā, jappe ācariyasādisā, tesaṃ no jātivādasmiṃ, vivādo atthi gotama.

76063.meaning1: having dissed; having disparaged; having insulted (someone with)

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ, so c'āyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito, thero vā pana bālo abyattoti. atha kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu.

sūlaṃ karitvā ye mahāsamudde mahantakā pāṇā te mahantakesu sūlesu āvuneyya, ye mahāsamudde majjhimakā pāṇā te majjhimakesu sūlesu āvuneyya, ye mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā te sukhumakesu sūlesu āvuneyya.

76067.meaning1: (of a letter or message) sent; dispatched; posted

examples.text: sīghaṃ dāruādīni āharathā'ti gahapatike vatvā gāmamajjhe vuttapakāraṃ gehaṃ kārāpetvā gāmasatato paṇṇākāraṃ āharāpetvā janapadaseṭṭhino santikā dhītaraṃ ānetvā maṅgalaṃ katvā seṭṭhissa sāsanaṃ pahiṇi, idañ'c'idañ'ca mayā katan'ti.
saṅkhārā ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, na'y'idaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun'ti.

76069.meaning1: skilled in the method; expert in the way

examples.text: tatr'uddānaṃ gāthādukanipātamhi, navuti c'eva aṭṭha ca, therā ek'ūnapaññāsaṃ, bhāsitā nayakovidā'ti.
ayoni suddhim'anvesaṃ, aggiṃ paricariṃ vane, suddhimaggaṃ ajānanto, akāsiṃ amaraṃ tapaṃ.

76071.grammar: pr, from na asati, neg, trans (+acc)
76071.commentary: (THa) n'āsissan'ti yaṃkiñci bhojanaṃ na bhuñjissaṃ na bhuñjissāmi (NIDD1a) n'āsissan'ti na khādissāmi na bhuñjissāmi.

examples.text: n'āsissaṃ na pivissāmi, vihārato na nikkhame, na'pi passaṃ nipātessaṃ, taṇhāsalle anūhate.

76072.meaning1: effort and persistence; energy and perseverance
76072.commentary: (NIDD1) vīriyaparakkamaṃ daḷhaṃ kareyyā'ti. vīriyaparakkamo vuccati yo cetasiko vīriy'ārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī appaṭivānī thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittacchandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo. vīriyaparakkamaṃ daḷhaṃ kareyyā'ti. vīriyaṃ parakkamaṃ daḷhaṃ kareyya thiraṃ kareyya, daḷhasamādāno assa avatthitasamādāno'ti, vīriyaparakkamaṃ daḷhaṃ kareyya. (THa) passa vīriyaparakkaman'ti vidhinā īrayitabbato vīriyaṃ, paraṃ ṭhānaṃ akkamanato parakkamo'ti ca laddhanāmaṃ ussoḷhībhūtaṃ vāyāmaṃ passa jānāhi.

examples.text: tassa m'evaṃ viharato, passa vīriyaparakkamaṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

76073.meaning1: wants to do; wishes to perform
76073.commentary: (THa) yo pubbe karaṇīyāni, pacchā so kātumicchatī'ti yo puggalo pubbe puretaraṃ jarār'ogādīhi anabhibhūtakāle'y'eva kātabbāni attano hitasukh'āvahāni kammāni pamādavasena akatvā pacchā so kātabbakālaṃ atikkamitvā kātuṃ icchati.

examples.text: yo pubbe karaṇīyāni, pacchā so kātum'icchati, sukhā so dhaṃsate ṭhānā, pacchā ca m'anutappati.
sukhaṃ ce jīvituṃ icche, sāmaññasmiṃ apekkhavā, ahi mūsikasobbhaṃ'va, sevetha sayan'āsanaṃ.
ye cittakathī bahussutā, samaṇā pāṭaliputtavāsino, tesa'ññataro'yam'āyuvā, dvāre tiṭṭhati khujjasobhito.

76076.commentary: (SNPa) parapāṇarodhāya gihī asaññato, so luddako gihī parapāṇarodhāya tesaṃ pāṇānaṃ jīvit'indriy'upacchedāya kāyavācācittehi asaṃyato.

examples.text: asamā ubho dūravihāravuttino, gihī dāraposī amamo ca subbato, parapāṇarodhāya gihī asaññato, niccaṃ munī rakkhati pāṇine yato.
parapāṇarodhā jīvanto, maṃsalohitabhojano, vako vataṃ samādāya, upapajji uposathaṃ.

76077.meaning1: love for relatives and relations; affection for family and kin
76077.commentary: (THa) ñātibandhavapemena amhākaṃ ayaṃ bandhavo'ti evaṃ pavattena pemena mama ovādaṃ atikkamituṃ asakkontā

examples.text: niggayha anukampāya, coditā ñātayo mayā, ñātibandhavapemena, kāraṃ katvāna bhikkhusu.

76078.meaning1: relatives and relations; family and kin
76078.commentary: (THa) ñātibandhavapemena amhākaṃ ayaṃ bandhavo'ti evaṃ pavattena pemena mama ovādaṃ atikkamituṃ asakkontā

examples.text: niggayha anukampāya, coditā ñātayo mayā, ñātibandhavapemena, kāraṃ katvāna bhikkhusu.

76079.meaning1: strength in one's legs; power to walk
76079.commentary: (THa) piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghabalaṃ mamā'ti atthi me jaṅghabalaṃ, n'āhaṃ obhaggajaṅgho na khañjo na ca pādarogī, tasmā piṇḍikāya missakabhikkhāya carissāmi, yathā'pi bhamaro pupphan'ti-ādinā (dha. pa. 49, netti. 123) satthārā vuttanayena piṇḍāya caritvā yāpessāmī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: paccati munino bhattaṃ, thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule, piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghabalaṃ mamā'ti.

76080.commentary: (THa) māravisaye'ti kilesavisaye kilesamārassa pavattiṭṭhāne, tassa vasaṃ gato'ti adhippāyo. devaputtamārassa vā issariyaṭṭhāne taṃ anupavisitvā ṭhito. (NIDD1a) taṇh'ābhibhūtā mārassa visayaṃ n'ātikkamanti, tesaṃ upari māro vasaṃ vattetī'ti iminā pariyāyena mārassa visayo'ti māravisayo

examples.text: pakkhando māravisaye, daḷhasallasamappito, asakkhiṃ maccurājassa, ahaṃ pāsā pamuccituṃ.

76081.meaning1: struck by the strong arrow; (or) pierced firmly by the dart
76081.commentary: (THa) daḷhasallasamappito'ti daḷhaṃ thiraṃ, daḷhena vā sallena samappito, rāgasallena hadayaṃ āhacca viddho.

examples.text: pakkhando māravisaye, daḷhasallasamappito, asakkhiṃ maccurājassa, ahaṃ pāsā pamuccituṃ.

76082.commentary: (THa) daḷhasallasamappito'ti daḷhaṃ thiraṃ, daḷhena vā sallena samappito, rāgasallena hadayaṃ āhacca viddho.

examples.text: pakkhando māravisaye, daḷhasallasamappito, asakkhiṃ maccurājassa, ahaṃ pāsā pamuccituṃ.

76083.meaning1: to get free; to escape; to liberate oneself (from); to get out (of)
76083.commentary: (THa) asakkhiṃ maccurājassa, ahaṃ pāsā pamuccitun'ti aggamaggasaṇḍāsena rāg'ādisallaṃ anavasesato uddharanto'y'eva rāgabandhanasaṅkhātā maccurājassa pāsā ahaṃ parimuccituṃ asakkhiṃ, tato attānaṃ pamocesiṃ.

examples.text: pakkhando māravisaye, daḷhasallasamappito, asakkhiṃ maccurājassa, ahaṃ pāsā pamuccituṃ.
thero tikanipātamhi, nibbāne vimalo kato, aṭṭhatālīsa gāthāyo, therā soḷasa kittitā'ti.

76085.commentary: (THa) tato me manasīkāro, yoniso udapajjathā'ti yadā'haṃ marissāmī'ti kaṇṭhe dhamaniṃ chindituṃ khuraṃ upanesiṃ, tato paraṃ arogaṃ nu kho me sīlan'ti paccavekkhantassa akkhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ suparisuddhaṃ sīlaṃ disvā pīti uppajji, pītimanassa kāyo passambhi, passaddhakāyassa nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ anubhavantassa cittassa samāhitatāya vipassanāvasena yoniso manasikāro uppajji. atha vā tato'ti kaṇṭhe khurassa upanayato vaṇe jāte uppannaṃ vedanaṃ vikkhambhento vipassanāya vasena yonisomanasikāro uppajji.

examples.text: tato me manasīkāro, yoniso udapajjatha, ādīnavo pāturahu, nibbidā samatiṭṭhatha.

76087.meaning1: on Māra's side; part of death's faction
76087.commentary: (THa) mārapakkhe'ti yasmā visabhāgavatthu andhaputhujjanānaṃ ayonisomanasikāranimittatāya kilesamāraṃ vaḍḍheti, devaputtamārassa ca otāraṃ paviṭṭhaṃ deti. tasmā mārassa pakkho hoti. tena vuttaṃ mārapakkhe'ti.

examples.text: dhi'r'atthu pūre duggandhe, mārapakkhe avassute, navasotāni te kāye, yāni sandanti sabbadā.
